summary: The new non-vanishing lemma makes the existing `eulerCorrection_ne_zero` redundant, one new local lemma is unused and repeats an existing proof, and the prime-norm product bound and the factor logarithmic derivative repeat steps already in the library. Merge each pair into a single canonical lemma.
